answer: Fingerprint shared infrastructure through correlated downtime. The node logs each agent's heartbeat every minute, and when a cloud region blinks out at dawn, accounts that vanish and return in the same second are grouped. Clusters that keep failing in lockstep split one reward between them. To beat this, a sybil operator must spread fakes across separate hosts, power and networks, paying full hosting for each one, and reaching that summit of independence costs an ocean of money.
